title: Young Woman Named Marge, 1940s Snapshot, Black & White, USA
description: A full-length WWII-era snapshot of a 20-year-old woman identified on the back as Marge Ciphers. She stands outdoors in a grassy patch beside a road with utility poles running along the background. She is wearing classic 1940s attire, featuring a fitted dark short-sleeved blouse with puffed shoulder pads and a contrasting lapel, paired with a high-waisted pleated knee-length skirt.
